tape-display.purpose: Uppercase condensed headings, panel titles, next-cue text and numerals in Tape.

book-mono.purpose: Cue numbers and file names in Book.

label.purpose: 12px field labels, flags, state text. The text floor.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Ease-out for all state changes and the toast entrance.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Background and border colour transitions on buttons. Reduced-motion collapses all durations to 1ms.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Only entrance animation in the product.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Standard 44px action on a raised surface.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--c-surface-2, #26262c); color: var(--c-text, #f2efe6); border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #34343b); border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); font: 600 1rem/1 var(--font-ui, Barlow, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--c-text, #f2efe6); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-focus, #f2efe6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Text-colour fill; one per view for the main non-cue action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--c-text, #f2efe6); color: var(--c-bg, #0d0d0f); border: 1px solid var(--c-text, #f2efe6); border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); font: 600 1rem/1 var(--font-ui, Barlow, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--c-bg, #0d0d0f); color: var(--c-text, #f2efe6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-focus, #f2efe6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Next Button
components.description: The single NEXT action; the only button in the next-cue colour.
components.css: .ds-btn-next { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--c-next, #ffd400); color: var(--c-on-next, #0d0d0f); border: 1px solid var(--c-next, #ffd400); border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); font: 700 1.25rem/1 var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); letter-spacing: var(--display-tracking, 0.06em); text-transform: var(--display-case, uppercase); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-next:hover { background: var(--c-on-next, #0d0d0f); color: var(--c-next, #ffd400); } .ds-btn-next:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-focus, #f2efe6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-muted, #a8a59b); } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--c-bg, #0d0d0f); color: var(--c-text, #f2efe6); border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #34343b); border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); font: 400 1rem/1.2 var(--font-ui, Barlow, sans-serif); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--c-muted, #a8a59b); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--c-focus, #f2efe6); outline: 2px solid var(--c-focus, #f2efe6); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Track Row
components.description: Sound row with category mark; playing state uses outline, text and pause icon.
components.css: .ds-track { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 52px; padding: 4px 8px; background: var(--c-surface-2, #26262c); border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); outline: 1px solid var(--mark); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-tape { flex: none; width: 10px; height: 28px; background: var(--mark); transform: skewX(var(--tape-skew, -10deg)); } .ds-track-name { flex: 1; font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 var(--font-mono, Barlow, sans-serif); color: var(--c-text, #f2efe6); } .ds-track-state { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mark); }

components.name: Cue Row (next)
components.description: A cue in the list; the next one carries the next-colour outline and numeral.
components.css: .ds-cue { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr; align-items: center; column-gap: 12px; min-height: 52px; padding: 4px 8px; background: var(--c-surface-2, #26262c); border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); outline: 1px solid var(--c-next, #ffd400); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-cue-num { font: 700 1.25rem/1 var(--font-mono, Barlow, sans-serif); color: var(--c-next, #ffd400); text-align: right; } .ds-cue-action { font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Next Band
components.description: Signature element: the next cue, the largest object on screen.
components.css: .ds-next-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-items: center; column-gap: 16px; padding: 16px; background: var(--next-fill, #ffd400); color: var(--next-ink, #0d0d0f); border: 1px solid var(--next-border, #ffd400); border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); } .ds-next-num { font: 700 var(--next-num-size, 3.75rem)/0.9 var(--font-mono, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); } .ds-next-what { font: 700 var(--next-what-size, 1.5rem)/1.2 var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); letter-spacing: var(--display-tracking, 0.06em); text-transform: var(--display-case, uppercase); } .ds-next-what mark { background: var(--next-what-bg, transparent); color: var(--next-what-ink, inherit); padding: 0 4px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Theme switch; checked segment fills with text colour.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-seg span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-muted, #a8a59b); border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #34343b); border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); } .ds-seg .ds-seg-on { background: var(--c-text, #f2efe6); color: var(--c-bg, #0d0d0f); border-color: var(--c-text, #f2efe6); }

narrative.northStar: The Call Sheet in the Dark
narrative.overview:
One component set, two worlds. The operator works in a dim wing on a laptop or tablet, so both themes are dark, flat and hairline-ruled, and both exist to make one thing unmistakable: the cue that fires next. Every sound carries its category the way a stagehand marks the floor, by a mark of material colour, never by decoration.

Spike Tape (default) is stage-floor black with matte gaffer-tape category marks cut at an angle: orange for effects, ice blue for BGM. Prompt Book is a charcoal page with chalk text, pencil-grey notes, Courier Prime cue numbers and file names, a filled pink BGM flag and a lime highlighter stripe behind the next cue's text.

A theme only swaps token values and a few type tokens. Components read semantic names and never a theme-specific one.
keyCharacteristics: Flat fills and 1px hairline rules; the board is a module grid whose gaps are rule colour.
One reserved signal colour per theme, used only for the next cue.
Category is a mark (tape strip or labelled flag), never the row's fill.
Product UI: fixed rem type, 44px targets, no decorative motion.
Offline: fonts self-hosted in public/fonts, icons drawn SVG from img/icons.svg.

rules.name: The Next-Only Rule
rules.body: The next-cue colour appears on the next band, the next cue row (outline and numeral), and the NEXT button. Never for focus, selection, hover, success or decoration.

rules.name: The Mark Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Category colour marks a row (strip, flag, playing outline, progress fill); rows stay on neutral surfaces.

rules.name: The Chalk Focus Rule
rules.body: The focus ring is the text colour in both themes, so it cannot be mistaken for the next cue.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Display face for headings and numerals, UI face for everything else, mono face only for cue numbers and file names.

rules.name: The Flat-Always Rule
rules.body: State is shown by border, outline or fill swap, never by shadow.

dos: Do read colour only from semantic tokens; add a theme by swapping values, not by adding components.
Do reserve the next-cue colour for the next cue, its row, numeral and button.
Do keep 44px targets, 12px minimum text, AA contrast, and the 2px chalk focus ring with 2px offset.
Do show playing as outline plus state text plus pause icon, so it never relies on colour alone.
Do use 160ms ease-out for state changes; honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do use icons from `img/icons.svg` and self-hosted fonts from `public/fonts`.
Do theme scrollbars, selection, caret and accent colour from tokens.
donts: Don't use the next-cue colour for focus, hover, success, category or decoration.
Don't add kickers, eyebrows or small uppercase lead-in labels above headings.
Don't use coloured side borders thicker than 1px, gradients, glows, text shadows or offset shadows.
Don't use emoji, glyph or icon-font icons, or load fonts or assets from a network.
Don't fill whole rows with a category colour; category is a mark.
Don't put theme conditionals in components beyond the existing mark and cue-grid rules in the page stylesheet.
